verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say it issues physical and virtual cards with configurable controls, real-time authorization and lifecycle management. These cards serve business, individual and joint account customers. Cards and accounts run on one unified infrastructure, ledger and API, which covers the core of account-tied cards with spend controls. missing for 10: any evidence of digital wallet support (e.g., Apple Pay/Google Pay provisioning), explicit confirmation that the cards are debit cards drawing on the deposit account, detailed API reference for card endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
